items.name: Protein Bite (Original)
items.description:
Whether hitting gym, including as a protein source in your pre- or post-workout meal plan, following a vegetarian diet, managing your weight and looking for extra protein, or recovering from illness and needing additional nourishment, Healthy & Happy Protein Bite (Original) makes meeting your daily protein needs easy and convenient—no calculations or meal prep required. Created with a heartfelt mission to support the nutritional needs of people across Myanmar.

Made primarily with locally sourced peanuts, oats, whole wheat, and chickpeas, each cookie provides 4 g of plant-based protein. Developed under the supervision of a nutrition professional, Healthy & Happy Protein Bite (Original) offers a convenient way to supplement your daily protein intake without the need for cooking or meal preparation.

The warm, comforting aroma of peanuts brings back the cozy feeling of home, while the addition of chocolate chips creates a rich, nutty sweetness that satisfies both your cravings and your heart.

Nutritional value per cookie is clearly stated on the product packaging.

items.name: Energy Bar
items.description:
Whether busy with work and have irregular meal times, traveling, looking for a boost in stamina and focus during your workouts, or searching for a protein-rich snack to keep you feeling full while managing your weight, those who often feel hungry, want a nutritious snack, or concerned about blood sugar spikes, Healthy & Happy Energy Bar is the perfect easy to store, easy to carry, and easy to enjoy, on-the-go choice.

Developed from nutrient-rich nuts and seeds under the supervision of a nutritionist, each bar delivers 7 g of plant-based protein to help keep you feeling satisfied for up to 6 hours. It’s a nourishing choice for those who tend to feel hungry frequently or are looking to manage your weight.

With no added sugar, artificial sweeteners, or preservatives, it’s a mindful snacking option for anyone seeking to reduce sugar intake and embrace healthier eating habits.

Nutritional value for each bar is provided on the packaging.

items.name: Nuts Bread

items.description: Enriched with nutrient-dense nuts and whole grains under the supervision of a nutritionist, Healthy & Happy Nuts Bread provides natural plant-based protein and healthy fats without added sugar or preservatives.

items.name: Spinach Cookies
items.highlight: A Green Goodness in Every Bite
items.description:
Made with real spinach, our innovative spinach cookies transform an everyday vegetable into a delicious, value-added snack.

Carefully Crafted under the supervision of a nutritionist, our cookies are thoughtfully developed with whole wheat, oats, real spinach, and unsalted butter, with no added sugar, artificial sweeteners, or preservatives for health-conscious consumers, as well as families looking for more wholesome treat for their children.

Designed with calorie-conscious snacking in mind, every bite delivers a naturally delicious aroma, a delightful crunch, and the benefits of vegetables in one tasty bite.

Nutrition value per cookie is clearly stated on the product packaging.

items.name: Cinnamon Cookies
items.description:
Our Healthy & Happy's Cinnamon Cookies bring together the distinctive flavor of cinnamon and wholesome ingredients to give you "the full feeling of goodness, healthiness, and balanced nutrition" in every bite, to create a delicious snack for those who want to make healthier choices.

Carefully crafted under the supervision of a nutritionist, our cookies are made primarily with whole wheat flour, oats, cinnamon powder, and unsalted butter, with no added sugar, artificial sweeteners, or preservatives.

Designed with calorie-conscious snacking in mind, every bite delivers a naturally rich flavor, a warm cinnamon aroma, and a satisfying crunch-making healthy-minded snacking a little more enjoyable for health-conscious individuals and families alike.

Nutritional value per cookie is clearly stated on the product packaging.

items.name: Oat Cookies
items.description:
For those who want to feel fuller with smaller portions while managing their weight, enjoy delicious treats without sacrificing taste, snack mindfully without feeling guilty, and choose a fiber-rich snack to help stay full longer, Healthy & Happy Oat Cookies is a deliciously satisfying, a smarter way to snack.

Not only with the simple goodness of oats with a gentle sweetness and a rich, buttery taste, but also made with whole wheat and unsalted butter under the supervision of a nutritionist, every bite delivers a uniquely crispy crunch that keeps you coming back for more.

Packed with fibers to help you feel fuller for longer, these cookies are the perfect choice for mindful snackers who want to manage their portions and enjoy delicious treats without compromising on taste.

Even better, they contain no added sugar, artificial sweeteners, or preservatives, making them a thoughtful snack choice for health-conscious individuals and families, including children.

Nutritional value per cookie is clearly stated on the product packaging.

items.name: Beetroot Cookies
items.description:
With its vibrant reddish-purple color and distinctive flavor, our Healthy & Happy Beetroot Cookies stand out from typical cookies by a delicious choice for those who want to enjoy a tasty snack while getting the nutritional benefits of vegetables, managing their weight, making healthier food choices, and being mindful of their blood sugar levels.

With the earthy aroma of beetroot carefully balanced, Healthy & Happy Beetroot Cookies combine the subtly sweet, nutty flavor of oats with whole wheat flour and unsalted butter, and crafted under the supervision of nutritionist, each bite delivers a satisfyingly crisp and crunchy texture that keeps you coming back for more.

Rich in dietary fiber, these cookies are a convenient choice for those managing their weight and looking for a more satisfying snack. Made without added sugar, artificial sweeteners, or preservatives, they are a thoughtful option for health-conscious individuals like diabetics and cancer patients and even children to enjoy as part of a balanced diet.

items.name: Nuts Cake
items.description:
Craving a little cake but worried about blood sugar, weight gain, or coughing? Our Healthy & Happy Nuts Cake, made with absolutely no added sugar, is here to satisfy your conflicting cravings and ease your concerns, so you can enjoy every bite with greater peace of mind without worrying about blood sugar, weight gain or coughing.

Although made primarily with whole wheat flour, our team has carefully crafted this cake to avoid the usual dryness and rough texture of whole wheat baked goods, making it smooth and easy to enjoy. Developed under the supervision of a nutritionist, each slice contains just 96 calories, allowing you to enjoy a delicious treat while being mindful of your calorie intake.

Thanks to the crushed ground nuts and seeds, every bite delivers a naturally sweet, rich, and nutty flavor reminiscent of a heavenly fruitcake, offering a delightful treat for those who are mindful of their sugar intake.

Nutrition value per slice is provided on packaging.
